tq.hud.combo: Combo multiplier ×{n}, capped at ×{cap} this stage
tq.how.mcq: Tap the answer. One tap locks it.
tq.how.order: Tap the items in order, then confirm.
tq.how.match: Pair each row with a value, then confirm.
tq.how.year: Tap the year. One tap locks it.
tq.error: The answer could not be checked. Your pick is kept.
tq.hint.struck: One wrong answer is struck out.
tq.pace.title: What happens after an answer
tq.stage.rule: {seconds} seconds a question. Combo up to ×{cap}.
tq.react.deep: A deep one, and you had it.
tq.react.fire: Five in a row. On fire.
tq.order.bank: Tap an item to place it next
tq.match.help: Tap a row, then its value. Tap a paired row to undo it.
tq.year.label: Years
tq.ready.rules: {lives} lives. Twelve questions in three stages: {s1}, then {s2}, then {s3} seconds each, combo up to ×{cap}. A hint costs {hint} points. The clock starts when the question is on screen.
tq.ready.rulesShort: {lives} lives, {s} seconds a question, one stage. A hint costs {hint} points. The clock starts when the question is on screen.
tq.ready.rulesPractice: No clock, no ranking, free hints. Nothing is scored.
tq.ready.note.history: This club's record is mostly dated events, so this run is History: questions about when things happened. It is not the standard three-stage run.
tq.ready.note.short: Short run: this club's record holds {n} distinct questions for this pick, so the run is {n} long and has one stage.
tq.ready.blocked.standard: Standard needs {need} questions for each stage. This club's record holds {counts} for stages 1, 2 and 3.
tq.ready.blocked.hard: Hard needs {need} questions for each stage. This club's record holds {counts} for stages 1, 2 and 3.
tq.ready.blocked.history: History opens when the record holds at least {need} distinct dated facts. It holds {counts}.
tq.ready.blocked.deck: This pick holds {counts} distinct facts and needs {need} to play honestly.
tq.revenge.explain: Of the questions you missed, {retired} were retired, {withdrawn} were withdrawn after a correction and {merged} repeat another fact.
tq.revenge.need: Revenge opens once at least {n} of your missed questions can be played.
tq.resume: A run is in progress: question {n} of {of}.
tq.resume.retired: A run from an earlier version of this club's record can no longer be resumed.
tq.offline.open: Could not reach the club's record to open the question. Your clock has not started.
tq.offline.start: Could not start the run. Check your connection and try again.
tq.err.BLOCKED: This club's record cannot field that run yet.
tq.err.VERSION_RETIRED: The club's record was updated since this run began. Start a new run.
tq.err.RUN_MISMATCH: A newer run replaced this one on this device.
tq.err.UNAVAILABLE: That question is no longer available.
